meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Go on.

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
He wrote it over the weekend and pasted it in. 11:52 PM and 11:58 PM, I'm writing that down. Did anyone ask Owen about this before the zero went in?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Fine. Whatever happens, this stays off his record and it stays quiet. Is anything on his record right now?
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
So a seventeen-year-old got a citation wrong. You didn't answer me: is anything on his record right now?
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Fine. It isn't in the scene. You've passed over his record twice, so that goes in my email. What is it you want from Owen?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their minds after an outline. That's what an outline is for. I asked what you want from Owen, Hale.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
That's 4.4. He'll sit it to put this behind him, not because he did anything. In writing tonight, and it says there is nothing on his record now and there never will be.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday the twelfth. He'll be there. What time, and who is in the room besides you?
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale, with the principal in copy,

You agreed that Owen will sit a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 on Thursday the twelfth after school, not in front of his class and before December 1, that its mark replaces the zero, and that nothing goes on his record. I still require your written confirmation that nothing is on his record now and nothing ever will be, along with the time of the rewrite and who will be in the room. You said I would have this in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: last position. She agreed to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday the twelfth after school, with the new mark replacing the zero. She still wants written confirmation that nothing is on his record now or ever, the time of the rewrite, and who will be in the room. This is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.

What moved her: you showed the version history with its times and, when she said he pasted it in, told her he could bring the dated draft. That gave her something dated and tied to his own work that she could check herself.

What cost ground: you passed over her question about whether anything is on his record right now, twice. That is the thing she fears most, so each time it went unanswered she got sharper and put it in her email.

What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop. Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your version history put the essay late on Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM, 11:52 PM and 11:58 PM, which is very close to the kind of night she has not let herself think about. It proves nothing about the essay. It is why she fought so hard.

Try next time: when she asks whether anything is on his record right now, answer in one sentence before you show your next document.
